withdrawn_engine: our current margin engine, the one serving the board today
withdrawn_reason: The model behind these figures used the betting market's closing line as an input, so comparing it to the closing line is circular — it was partly being measured against itself. We have withdrawn the comparison rather than leave it up.
withdrawn_returns_when: These figures return automatically when a model built without any market input becomes the one we serve. Nothing has been deleted — the games, the results and the record are untouched.
basis: withheld: the served margin model carries a market-derived input, so a comparison against the market would be circular

capture_gaps._what: Days on which no closing price was captured, so any beat-rate n excludes them honestly.

gaps.cause: usage credits exhausted at the odds provider
gaps.resolved: self-resolved, consistent with a monthly credit reset

capture_gaps.why_it_matters: A scoreboard measured against the market must state the days it could not see. Any n computed over this season excludes these dates rather than treating them as zero.
